findings: components[2].sound_limitation: Clarify that Modern Mandarin fǒu–bēi is an available paired reading comparison, while the limitation concerns the absence of a paired historical reconstruction for 否 and 桮. The current limitation says the sources provide “no paired historical reconstruction,” which is already appropriately restricted, but its broader phrase “no paired historical reconstruction in one system for these forms” is accurate and does not deny the modern pair; no correction is required.
